declarations.docstring: The auxiliary action associated with an invertible matrix leaves the degree of a homogeneous matrix polynomial unchanged.
The distinguished auxiliary polynomial in the matrix entries is homogeneous of degree equal to the matrix size.
Above the matrix-size bound, intersecting the auxiliary submodule with a homogeneous piece is the image of the correspondingly shifted homogeneous piece.
The component in degree equal to the matrix size plus an offset of an auxiliary-polynomial product is obtained from the component at that offset.
The auxiliary polynomial map sends the degree-d homogeneous subspace into the homogeneous subspace whose degree is shifted by the matrix size.
Applying the auxiliary polynomial map to a degree-d homogeneous polynomial produces a homogeneous polynomial with the matrix size added to its degree.
An auxiliary natural-number-indexed family of subrepresentations of the matrix-polynomial representation.
The underlying submodule of the auxiliary degree subrepresentation is the homogeneous submodule at that degree.
Acting by an invertible matrix on the matrix-polynomial representation preserves homogeneity and its degree.
An auxiliary degree-indexed family of subrepresentations for the induced representation.
The auxiliary polynomial map attached to a square matrix preserves homogeneous degree.
